text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, got it! Understood!
Please connect the live feed to each of the
stages as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!
Word has it that every venue is packed and
running smoothly!
Now it's time for Part Two to begin...
and then!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It will serve as the unveiling of
'GIRLS' LEGEND U'.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This song will be performed simultaneously
not only here on Stage A, but on Stage B,
Stage C...
and all the other stages as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume will sing at once,
hyping up the crowd together with the
fans!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
our technicians put all their power into
this.
I promise it will be an unforgettable
show.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume, the fans...
—and you, too!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I can feel it.
The fervor brimming with everyone's
expectations, the roaring cheers.
Truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is an honor.
I cannot afford to betray their faith in
me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As the Rose King,
I shall answer every expectation in the
finest possible fashion!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Crossing through spring, summer, autumn,
and winter,
yearning and longing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's a fascinating song, isn't it?
Because in the end,
it all leads back to running.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's just like us horse girls,
isn't it?
I think the lyrics turned out truly
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Inhaaaale... exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone!
I'm gonna pour all my heart and feelings
into our song for you~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Through this concert,
you shall gain power! Expand your potential,
elevate the utility of your connections,
and surpass even your very limits!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, and that goes for Tachyon, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's not over yet, it can't end here!
Let's all sing together!
'GIRLS' LEGEND U'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is for 'GIRLS' LEGEND U'
to play across the stage――
